title: War
label: White label

type.basis: Jon E Cash is credited with inventing sublow, and War is among the best-known Black Ops productions. The case rests on record-shop and later sources (grade C); a stronger candidate may exist among earlier Black Ops white labels.

sound.text: Digi-dub style horns (also on 'Battle'); Cash's sound runs at about 140 bpm with heavy, exaggerated bass and hard drums.
Rubadub: drums 'hard as nails', bass 'tuned for maximum rave damage' (compilation-level).

context.text: Jon E Cash gave Slimzee the dub at a Sidewinder rave; Slimzee played it on Rinse twice each Sunday, reportedly the only DJ with it for two years before release.
Jon E Cash, a West London artist and founding member of the Black Ops crew, is credited with inventing sublow, a West London pocket of grime.
Shop copy for the reissue says he released the white labels of 'Drop Top Bimmer Kid' and named the style he fused from garage and hip-hop roots sublow.
Last.fm lists 'War' among the top Black Ops productions.

rels.other: Novelist vocal over Jon E Cash's 'War' (2015)

uncertainty: The release year depends on Complex's 'released on white label back in '03'. Boiler Room's 'two years before its release' suggests the dub circulated from about 2001. No label or catalogue number was found, and Discogs was blocked. Sources on sublow are mainly record-shop copy for the reissue.
tracklist: Collected on the Sneaker Social Club compilation 'Sublow' (SNKRLP015), which covers beats from 1999 to 2005.

audit.note: Not found; Jon E Cash artist pages and 'Still at War' (DA Black OP's) surfaced, not War.

Not found via web searches restricted to qobuz.com (Qobuz's own catalogue search needs JS/app); absence is less certain than on Apple. Kurupt FM compilation has a different Jon E Cash track ('Cash Beat AKA: Hoods Up Dub').

Digital re-release dated 21 Dec 2023, notes say '2003 release'; includes 'WAR BONUS'. A track 'WAR' on album SUBLOW (2025) has tags: edm, electronic, ukg, grime, instrumental, sublow, London (https://jonecash.bandcamp.com/track/war).
